I told Pree in a #central-team thread that the settled figure is 87 seats.

- **What I checked:** Pree is a member of #central-team, so I read that channel. Hollis posted 268 there on Oct 14 and corrected it to 87 the same morning. Nothing has changed the figure since.
- **The brain:** the fact I saved about the correction didn't come back when I looked it up. The recall ran in keyword-only mode, so I can't tell whether the fact is missing or the search just didn't match it. The channel history alone is enough to settle the answer.
- **Sharing:** a seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, and Pree is on the account's team. So it could be shared, and no approval was needed.
